chosenEquipment.moralCondition: The wielder must have protected someone with less power without demanding ownership or worship.
chosenEquipment.acceptance: Aegis Core illuminates and the shield permits equipment.
chosenEquipment.rejection: Remains dormant; no item loss; opens a personal quest.
chosenEquipment.questHook: Return to the person the wielder failed to protect.

chosenEquipment.moralCondition: The bearer must rally a mixed Union without naming an enemy race as inherently lesser.
chosenEquipment.questHook: Repair a Union split by prejudice.

chosenEquipment.moralCondition: The wielder must acknowledge consequences rather than romanticize victory.
chosenEquipment.questHook: Find the civilian record missing from an old battle.

chosenEquipment.moralCondition: Must have built something that benefits people outside the wielder’s own group.
chosenEquipment.acceptance: Adapts into a legal tool family.
chosenEquipment.questHook: Build an embassy approach with three cultures.

chosenEquipment.moralCondition: Must preserve knowledge without using it to dominate a weaker person.
chosenEquipment.questHook: Choose public truth over private advantage.

chosenEquipment.moralCondition: Must have returned for someone after extraction was already possible.
chosenEquipment.questHook: Find a missing team before floor reset.
